name: Hatsumoude! Miko-chan ni Ecchi na Koto ga Dekichau Omikuji!?
original_name: 初詣!巫女ちゃんにエッチなことができちゃうおみくじ⁉
source:
This is a game where you draw fortune slips at a shrine during the first shrine visit of the year.
The story changes based on the result of the slip. With each slip a new H-scene with a shrine maiden will happen.
translation:
这是一款在新年首次参拜神社时抽签的游戏。
剧情会根据签文的结果发生变化。每抽一签，都会展开一段与巫女之间的新H场景。
